title: Energizing Ethiopian Vermicelli Jjigae
description: A resinous, cheese-pull, energizing Ethiopian dish featuring vermicelli rice noodles, beurre-monte, gluten-free-friendly, served in injera form.
instructions: Cook the vermicelli rice noodles according to package instructions.
Prepare the homemade beurre-monte by whisking together 1 egg yolk, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, and 1.5 tablespoons melted butter until thick and emulsified.
In a large bowl, mix together injera flour, water, and a pinch of salt until a smooth batter forms.
Let the injera batter rest for 30 minutes before cooking on a hot skillet or injera pan, until the edges start to curl and the center is dry.
Warm the ghee in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the cured beef to the ghee and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the onion and garlic to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the mitmita spice blend to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the cooked vermicelli noodles to the pan and stir to combine with the beef and spice mixture.
Butter the inside of a piece of injera bread and place a portion of the noodle mixture in the center.
Top with feta cheese and a spoonful of Salsa Oromo, and then fold the injera bread to enclose.
